app.name: maewmeet
app.description: See which days your friends are all free, and make plans in one place.

login.title: Sign in
login.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots or underscores
login.notYet: Signing in isn’t available yet. This is a preview of the screen.

locked.title: Temporarily locked
locked.hint: While it’s locked, even the right PIN won’t work. If you’ve forgotten it, you can ask for a reset.
locked.long: Too many tries. Try again in {hours} h {minutes} min.

resetBanner.pending: Reset request sent. Waiting for an admin to approve it.
resetBanner.approved: Your reset was approved. Use the PIN 123456 on this device until {expires}.

home.title: No plans yet
home.body: Find a day when everyone’s free, then make a plan from it.

homeNoGroup.title: You’re not in a group yet
homeNoGroup.body: Start a group with your friends, then see which days work for everyone.
homeNoGroup.joinCode: Got an invite code? Enter it

calendar.title: No one’s added busy time this month
calendar.body: Add yours first so friends know when you’re tied up.

calendarNoGroup.title: No group calendar yet
calendarNoGroup.body: Join or create a group and the calendar will show when everyone’s free.

calendarSolo.title: It’s just you in this group
calendarSolo.body: Invite friends to see which days you’re all free.

groups.title: You’re not in a group yet
groups.body: Create a group, then bring friends in with an invite code.
groups.joinCode: Got an invite code? Enter it

me.title: Account settings aren’t here yet
me.body: You can change language and theme for now. Your name and PIN come after you sign in.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link might be wrong, or the page has moved.

prefs.savedLocalOnly: Changed on this device, but we couldn’t save it to your account.

error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
error.network: Can’t connect. Check your connection and try again.

legend.title: What the colours mean
legend.countNote: Numbers show how many of the {total} members are free that day.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: Sign in with a username and a 6-digit PIN. No email needed.
signup.usernameHint: 3–20 characters: a–z, numbers, dots or underscores
signup.displayNameHint: Friends in your groups see this name. Up to 40 characters, any language.
signup.pinRemember: Keep your PIN somewhere safe. There’s no email to recover it, so if you forget it an admin has to approve a reset.

pinChange.hintConfirm: Enter the same 6 digits once more

pinRules.title: What makes a valid PIN
pinRules.notRepeated: Not all the same digit, like 000000
pinRules.notSequence: Not a straight run, like 123456 or 654321
pinRules.why: That’s all it takes to rule out the easy guesses. Pick numbers you’ll remember but others won’t guess.

forgot.title: Forgot your PIN?
forgot.intro: Tell us your username. An admin will check the request and let you set a new PIN.
forgot.deviceNote: Once it’s approved, sign in from this device. If you switch devices or clear your browser data, this request won’t work and you’ll need to send a new one.

pending.title: Request sent
pending.body: An admin will review it, which can take a little while. If you remember your PIN in the meantime, just sign in as usual and the request is cancelled for you.
pending.hint: You can close this page and check back on the sign-in screen.
pending.expiry: If nobody answers within 7 days, the request expires and you can send a new one.

approved.title: Approved
approved.body: Sign in with your username and the PIN 123456, then set a new PIN right away.
approved.thisDevice: Works only on this device, the one you sent the request from.

closed.title: This request is closed
closed.body: It expired, was declined, or has already been used. You can send a new one.

setPin.title: Set a new PIN
setPin.intro: For your security, choose a new PIN before you carry on. 123456 can’t be used again.
setPin.doneOthers: Any other devices you were signed in on have been signed out.

adminResets.title: PIN reset requests
adminResets.warningTitle: Check with the owner before approving
adminResets.warningBody: Anyone who knows a username can ask for a reset in their name. Contact the owner outside the app, by chat or a call, and compare the time, device and country with what they tell you. If they don’t match, or they didn’t ask, decline.

approveSheet.title: Approve request from {username}
approveSheet.body: {username}’s PIN will become 123456 for 24 hours, on the device that sent the request only. Their old PIN stops working straight away.
approveSheet.check: I’ve confirmed with the account owner outside the app

rejectSheet.title: Decline request from {username}
rejectSheet.body: The request will be closed. Their current PIN keeps working.

empty.title: No requests waiting
empty.body: When someone taps Forgot PIN, their request shows up here.

me.title: Me
me.logoutAllHint: Signs you out on every device you’ve used, including this one.

logoutAllConfirm.title: Sign out everywhere?
logoutAllConfirm.body: You’ll need to sign in again on every device, this one included. Your current PIN still works.

pin.title: Change PIN
pin.done: PIN changed. Your other devices have been signed out.

pin_reset.approved: An admin approved your PIN reset request (valid until {expiresAt}).
pin_reset.cancelled_by_login: Your PIN reset request was cancelled because you signed in with your current PIN. If you didn’t send it, change your PIN in the Me tab.

errors.VALIDATION: Some fields need a fix. Check the highlighted ones and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find that. It may have been deleted, or you’re no longer in that group.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do that. Ask a group admin if you think you should.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone changed this in the meantime. Reload to see the latest, then try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: That’s a lot at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.FEATURE_DISABLED: This is turned off for now. Try again later.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.AUTH_MAINTENANCE: Sign-in and sign-up are paused for maintenance. Your data is safe, and this won’t count as a wrong PIN. Try again later.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended. If you think that’s a mistake, contact the app admin.
errors.PIN_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Set a new PIN to continue.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong username or PIN.{attemptsRemaining, plural, =0 {} =1 { One try left before a short lock.} other { # tries left.}}
errors.LOGIN_LOCKED: Too many tries. Try again in {retryAfterMin, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That username’s taken. Try another one.
errors.USERNAME_FORMAT: Usernames are 3–20 characters: a–z, 0–9, dots and underscores only.
errors.PIN_FORMAT: Your PIN needs to be exactly 6 digits, with no letters or spaces.
errors.PIN_MISMATCH: The PINs don’t match. Try again.
errors.PIN_TOO_WEAK: That PIN is easy to guess. All the same digit (like 000000) or a straight run (like 123456 or 654321) isn’t allowed. Try a different mix.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: We couldn’t verify that request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.ADMIN_TRANSFER_REQUIRED: Make someone else the group admin first, then try again.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: This code doesn’t work. Ask someone in the group for a new one.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: No one has that username. Check the spelling, or send them an invite code instead.
errors.INVALID_RANGE: The end has to be after the start.
errors.INVALID_DATE: That date doesn’t exist. Pick one from the calendar.
errors.INVALID_LOCAL_TIME: That time doesn’t exist in this time zone because the clocks change. Pick another time.
errors.TIME_NOT_ON_STEP: Times go in half-hour steps, like 18:00 or 18:30.
errors.DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: That date is outside the range we support. Pick one from the calendar.
errors.RANGE_TOO_LARGE: That date range is too long. Try a shorter one.
errors.INVALID_TIMEZONE: We don’t recognise that time zone. Pick one from the list.
errors.INVALID_WINDOW: The group’s free-time hours don’t work. The end has to be after the start.
errors.INVALID_MAP_URL: We can’t read a location from that link. Try copying it from the Share button in your maps app.
errors.INVALID_COORDINATES: Those coordinates don’t look right. Check the latitude and longitude.
errors.APPOINTMENT_CANCELLED: This plan was cancelled, so it can’t be changed.
